ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.role: joiner for the agent-name list inside the built-in installation offer
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.tone: neutral inline enumeration; preserve names verbatim, no sentence punctuation
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.length: Two placeholders plus four characters for pair/final joins, or two for middle joins; variable-width names, no fixed character budget.
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.note: French uses et without a preceding comma for a pair and for the final item, and a comma followed by one ordinary space between middle items. No space precedes the comma; the French narrow no-break space before : ; ! ? does not apply here. Each arm owns its separator and spaces. Keep the select labels and agent display names unchanged.

placeholders.position: pair for a two-name list, middle for non-final joins, end (the other arm) for the final join of three or more names
placeholders.head: first name or the already joined preceding names; preserve verbatim
placeholders.tail: next agent display name; preserve verbatim
